chapter.heading: A Song of degrees.
chapter.v:
In my
distress I cried unto the LORD, and he heard me.

Deliver my
soul, O LORD, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

What shall
be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

Sharp arrows
of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

Woe is
me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

My soul
hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

I am
for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
